_meta.author: Eduventure (original text)
_meta.note: Fun facts a pet brings back from an adventure. Kid-friendly, widely documented facts; a reviewer should check them (and the Malay) before launch.

facts.en: Mount Kinabalu in Sabah is Malaysia's highest mountain, about 4,095 metres tall.
facts.ms: Gunung Kinabalu di Sabah ialah gunung tertinggi di Malaysia, kira-kira 4,095 meter tinggi.

facts.en: The Rafflesia, found in Malaysia's rainforests, has the biggest single flower in the world: up to about 1 metre across.
facts.ms: Rafflesia yang tumbuh di hutan hujan Malaysia mempunyai bunga tunggal terbesar di dunia, selebar kira-kira 1 meter.

facts.en: Malaysia has 13 states and 3 federal territories.
facts.ms: Malaysia mempunyai 13 negeri dan 3 wilayah persekutuan.

facts.en: The bunga raya (hibiscus) is Malaysia's national flower.
facts.ms: Bunga raya ialah bunga kebangsaan Malaysia.

facts.en: The Malayan tiger is Malaysia's national animal.
facts.ms: Harimau Malaya ialah haiwan kebangsaan Malaysia.

facts.en: Malaysia became independent on 31 August 1957. We celebrate it as Hari Merdeka.
facts.ms: Malaysia mencapai kemerdekaan pada 31 Ogos 1957. Kita menyambutnya sebagai Hari Merdeka.

facts.en: Malaysia was formed on 16 September 1963, the day we call Hari Malaysia.
facts.ms: Malaysia dibentuk pada 16 September 1963, hari yang kita panggil Hari Malaysia.

facts.en: The Petronas Twin Towers in Kuala Lumpur are 452 metres tall. They were the world's tallest buildings from 1998 to 2004.
facts.ms: Menara Berkembar Petronas di Kuala Lumpur setinggi 452 meter. Ia bangunan tertinggi di dunia dari 1998 hingga 2004.

facts.en: The kancil (mouse-deer) is one of the smallest hoofed animals in the world.
facts.ms: Kancil ialah antara haiwan berkuku yang paling kecil di dunia.

facts.en: The rhinoceros hornbill is Sarawak's state bird. Sarawak is called the Land of the Hornbills.
facts.ms: Burung kenyalang ialah burung negeri Sarawak. Sarawak digelar Bumi Kenyalang.

facts.en: The rainforest of Taman Negara is often said to be about 130 million years old, one of the oldest in the world.
facts.ms: Hutan hujan Taman Negara sering dikatakan berusia kira-kira 130 juta tahun, antara yang tertua di dunia.

facts.en: The Rajang River in Sarawak is the longest river in Malaysia.
facts.ms: Sungai Rajang di Sarawak ialah sungai terpanjang di Malaysia.

facts.en: The Sarawak Chamber in Gunung Mulu National Park is one of the largest known cave chambers in the world.
facts.ms: Sarawak Chamber di Taman Negara Gunung Mulu ialah antara ruang gua terbesar yang diketahui di dunia.

facts.en: Wild orangutans live only on the islands of Borneo and Sumatra, including Sabah and Sarawak.
facts.ms: Orang utan liar hanya hidup di Pulau Borneo dan Sumatera, termasuk Sabah dan Sarawak.

facts.en: The Penang Bridge, opened in 1985, links Penang Island to the mainland.
facts.ms: Jambatan Pulau Pinang yang dibuka pada tahun 1985 menghubungkan Pulau Pinang dengan tanah besar.

facts.en: Malaysia lies close to the equator, so it is warm all year round.
facts.ms: Malaysia terletak berhampiran garisan khatulistiwa, jadi cuacanya panas sepanjang tahun.

facts.en: The wau bulan is a traditional moon-shaped kite from Kelantan.
facts.ms: Wau bulan ialah layang-layang tradisional berbentuk bulan dari Kelantan.

facts.en: Congkak is a traditional board game where players move seeds or shells from hole to hole.
facts.ms: Congkak ialah permainan papan tradisional di mana pemain memindahkan biji atau cengkerang dari lubang ke lubang.

facts.en: Batik is a way of decorating cloth with wax and dye. Malaysian batik often shows flowers and leaves.
facts.ms: Batik ialah cara menghias kain dengan lilin dan pewarna. Batik Malaysia selalunya bercorak bunga dan daun.

facts.en: The proboscis monkey, with its big nose, lives only on the island of Borneo.
facts.ms: Monyet belanda yang berhidung besar hanya hidup di Pulau Borneo.
